title: fix(lint)!: refuse an app nav `visible` that does not parse, and page variables that are duplicated, unnamed or wrong-typed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XT5d6rCa6Ukdbma6oi1ufki)_

Fixes #28663

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a navigation entry's `visible` grammar or the page `variables` list; the refusals carry their own fix and `os explain` entries.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：应用导航项的 `visible` 写成解析不了的 CEL（如 `'org_owner' in`），现在和页面组件的 `visibleWhen` 一样被拒：保存、草稿诊断、发布、`os validate` 四处同一条结论。页面 `variables` 新增一条规则：重名、空名、默认值类型和声明类型不符（`number` 配 `"abc"`）都拒。
- **为什么改**：以前这两类都能保存、草稿显示 valid、照常发布；导航项到了控制台解析失败，对所有人隐藏，作者毫不知情。变量重名时控制台只留最后一个，默认值类型错则所有读它的谓词比的都是错类型的值。
- **风险与回滚**：低到中。只收紧写入口，已存的应用和页面照常加载、照常服务，只有下次保存才被判。仓内语料（examples 和平台包）里 1 个导航 `visible`、5 个页面变量，零命中。回滚即撤回 `@objectstack/lint` 的这次改动。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`（新增的导航遍历和 `syntaxFinding`）；`packages/lint/src/validate-page-variables.ts`（新规则）；`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`（家族加 `app`、新规则注册）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.app-nav-visible-predicate-writes.test.ts src/runtime-gate.page-variable-writes.test.ts`，预期 31/31 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`: `validateVisibilityPredicates` now also walks `apps[].navigation`, `apps[].areas[].navigation` and every entry's `children`, and runs the existing `visibility-predicate-syntax` judgment (`celRefusal`, formula's `parseCelToAstWithReason`, no second parser) on each entry's `visible`. A bare string and a `{ dialect: 'cel' }` envelope are judged (the console evaluates both on the CEL engine since #27457); an envelope of another dialect is the console's legacy reading and a boolean is no predicate, so neither is judged. The finding is located at the key (`apps[0].navigation[0].visible`). The syntax finding is built by one helper, `syntaxFinding`, for page/view elements and nav entries alike; only two words move per surface: the consequence clause (a nav gate falls closed, so "the entry is hidden from every viewer") and the remedy example (`'org_admin' in current_user.positions`, the spec's own nav example, since a nav entry binds no `record`). Page and view wording is byte-identical (live probe below shows the same page message on base and head).
- Only the syntax verdict runs on a nav entry, by measurement: the family's reference verdicts judge roots a view or page binds (`record`, `current_user`, `page`), and a nav entry binds `current_user`, `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user`, `features` (plus `data` beside a `dataSource`), so `features.cloudManaged != true` would be refused as an unbound root.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-page-variables.ts` (new) with three ids: `page-variable-name-duplicate` (at the second entry's `name`, naming the first index), `page-variable-name-empty` (empty or blank), `page-variable-default-type` (a `defaultValue` of another kind than `type`: string for `string`/`record_id`, finite number, boolean, plain object, array; `null` admitted for any type; no `type` = the schema's default `string`). No `packages/spec/**` edit: the rule needs no shape change.
- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`: the visibility family (`validateVisibilityPredicates`, `validatePredicatePathRefs`) declares `runtimeTypes: ['view', 'page', 'app']` (the family stays on one type set, as `authoring-rule-wiring.test.ts` pins; the path rule judges nothing on an app). `validatePageVariables` is registered gating, `CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, `runtimeTypes: ['page']`, after `validatePrintPageBlocks`. No gate change in `metadata-protocol`: `app` already maps to `apps`, and save, draft `_diagnostics` and publish all read `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules`.
- `packages/lint/src/index.ts`: exports the rule and its three id constants. `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`: three `os explain` entries, and a paragraph on `visibility-predicate-syntax` for nav entries.
- `content/docs/**` (4 CLI transcripts): `author-time rules (57)` → `(58)`, the count the registry derives with the new rule (`check:docs-transcript-drift`).
- `.changeset/28663-nav-visible-syntax-page-variables.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

**Migration note.** Nav `visible` values in the shipped corpus: 1 (`examples/app-crm` `current_user.can('crm_opportunity', 'read')`), 0 refused. Page variables: 5 on 2 showcase pages, 0 refused. `os validate` on `example-crm`, `example-showcase`, `example-todo` at head: exit 0, 0 findings of the new ids. Stored apps and pages keep loading and serving; only the next save of one with a finding is refused.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.app-nav-visible-predicate-writes.test.ts` (new): the card's `visible: "'org_owner' in"` top-level, inside an area and inside a group's `children` is refused at the app door at the key, and `os validate` (`runAuthoringRules('validate')`) gives the same finding; the `{ dialect: 'cel' }` envelope too. Controls admitted at both: `'org_owner' in current_user.positions` (string and envelope), `features.cloudManaged != true`, `current_user.can(...)`, `user.isPlatformAdmin == true`, a `template` envelope, `true`.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.page-variable-writes.test.ts` (new): duplicate, empty, blank, `number`+`"abc"`, `boolean`/`array`/`object`/`record_id` mismatches and an untyped number default, each refused at the page door with its path, with door/`os validate` parity; four declaration sets admitted (the showcase's two included, `null` defaults, `[]`); three faults on one page are three findings.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`: five new rows in the #26707 table (nav top-level, nav in an area, the three variable faults): the draft saves, reads `valid: false` with the publish's own words, and publish refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA`; clean nav + variables read `valid: true` and publish; paths are item-relative (`areas.0.navigation.0.visible`, `variables.0.defaultValue`).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: the active `saveMetaItem` refuses the app (door finding = build finding key by key, nothing stored) and each variable fault; clean controls land.
- Pins updated for the app door's new rule list: `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` (two), `validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` (one), and the page door's ordered list in `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope by the order, each measured at head on the same boot and still admitted (`_diagnostics {"valid":true}`), not fixed here:

- A page variable `source` naming a component the page does not hold (`source: "no_such_component"`): admitted.
- A `visibleWhen` reading an undeclared `page.nosuch`: admitted.
- Seen beside the work: a nav `visible` that is flawless CEL but over the parse budget (a 90-clause `||` chain) is admitted at the draft read; the page-side twin is `visibility-predicate-over-budget`. Not wired here because the ruling names the syntax judgment only.

Also noted: when a nav `visible` uses an operator from another language (`===`), the remedy's example comes from the shared operator table and is `record`-rooted (`record.country == 'USA'`). The operator correction itself is right on any surface.

Declaration: the claim's line reads `Clause-②: no`; this body and the changeset carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, because `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` beside a line without the `(narrowing)` arm. The order's Declarations section names it a narrowing.
